dpo.title: Data Protection
dpo.body: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, delete and oppose the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at dpo@manco.paris.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This website uses cookies strictly necessary for its operation. Audience measurement cookies may be used with your consent. You can manage your preferences via the hu-manity.co widget at the bottom left of your screen.

esg.title: ESG / SRI Policy
esg.body: MANCO PARIS integrates environmental, social and governance (ESG) criteria into its management processes in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements. Our ESG policy is available upon request.

sfdr.title: SFDR — Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation
sfdr.body: In application of Regulation (EU) 2019/2088, MANCO PARIS publishes information relating to the consideration of sustainability risks in its investment decisions and remuneration policy.

vote.title: Voting Policy
vote.body: MANCO PARIS exercises voting rights attached to securities held by the funds it manages, in accordance with its voting policy adopted by the Board. The annual voting rights report is available upon request.

remuneration.title: Remuneration Policy
remuneration.body: MANCO PARIS remuneration policy complies with the requirements of the AIFM Directive and UCITS V Directive. It aims to promote sound and effective risk management. Details are available upon request.
